mechanics: Tier rolls: a deposit or tree spot rolls its Great/Superior/Amazing tier at random, and higher Area Rank raises the odds. A 'min_rank' is the earliest rank a tier has been seen, not a guaranteed spawn (GG).
Gold-crown bosses and nodes appear from Area Rank 5 and have a 5-minute respawn after you defeat or gather them (kokorogu, GG).
Silver-crown monsters have no cooldown; switching any tower's Area Rank or using the Anywhere Gate respawns them instantly (kokorogu).

Legendary challenges: solo they appear at random from Area Rank 3; in multiplayer when the challenge gauge fills. Changing any tower's rank rerolls them map-wide. Legendary gathering targets give 1,000 Area Points (GG, kokorogu).
Moltana Wastes and Scorchrock Mountain never spawn legendary challenges (kokorogu).
Cave nodes (e.g. Agekara Cave Platinum) respawn when you leave and re-enter the cave (GameWith, Game8).
